notes.title: Progress Report #3
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]Development on Chapter 4A is going well! This update is shaping up to be our biggest one yet and so it is taking longer than usual. I'm optimistic it will be well worth the wait.[/p][p][/p][p]Chapter 4A will be the first half of the final chapter of Volume 1. This chapter marks the halfway mark of the story and I want it to end with a bang(may or may not be literal)! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050597/798bed1d6a1b42a8b95adda12802fb2a1af05f5e.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050597/e51756949837e7b2323a03b70183b6d591e66983.png"][/img][/p][p]This update will have a bit of everything you would expect from the story, including some romance and lewd scenes, but also the biggest action sequence thus far.[/p][p]Right now we are about 60% done with rendering. A lot of the simpler scenes are ready, but there are a lot of complex scenes and renders in this update so everything hinges on how smoothly they could be produced next month.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050597/8cf5587a7a82a0c9453baaecc0af1226fc9109be.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050597/4e9c981b969358cc4f3f6392fbf9c971dbabd3e3.png"][/img][/p][p]While there are still some ways to go, I'll be posting previews more and more frequently as we approach a release date. Please stay tune for more![/p]

notes.title: Patch notes for 27/2/2025
notes.notes:
A new update has been released addressing the issues with the Codex for some players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050597/d1729633767a7b752f4ace566bc48b5d281dca0e.png[/img]

The Repair Codex option in Preferences will unlock everything your save should have by the end of the current content. In order to avoid potential spoilers, please only use this option if you have problems with your Codex and you have already finished the latest content. 

We also recommend using this option only with your save file loaded, this will ensure the Repair function be able to read your save and unlock entries appropriately based on your choices.

notes.title: Chapter 3 Finale Out Now!
notes.notes:
Hello!

The long awaited continuation is out now!

-1578 renders

-Scene Replay rework

-Chinese and Russian support*

Sharpening and film grain options are customizable in Preferences. Sharpening in particular are recommended for mobile screens or resolutions higher than 1080p.

Please enjoy!

notes.title: Progress Report #1
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's been a month since the game released on Steam! Thank you everyone for playing the game. I hope you all enjoyed it. Today, I want to share some news about the upcoming update - Chapter 3B.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050597/0e1abde081875e4bc86a1d817ee4978444a820f1.png[/img]

Production on the update has been on going for a while now. Most of the scenes are complete.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050597/75f3fd6f80c976b91eaae3348ee647f3136e242d.png[/img]

But there still remain a few big ones that need to be rendered. And that is what I'll be doing for the next month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050597/99cea8a5454a27061bc124bd092e2ccdef6fe19c.png[/img]

After all the images are rendered, it usually take a week to edit and code them into the game. A further week will be needed to playtest. Because this Steam release was the first update with additional language support, it might take more time to get everything tested.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050597/6da4eb1ada7038142bc8a9612edbc99e65593ad7.png[/img]

Keep an eye out for future progress reports as we get closer to the release of the next update!

notes.title: Patch notes for 3/9/2024
notes.notes:
Turkish translation added!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45050597/447208a477598a0c4da12460cb6171a79f004d83.png[/img]
You can access the language options from Preference.

We also released a fix to a problem introduce in the September 1st patch. New players who started the game for the first time since that build would inadvertently unlock 12 out 14 achievements among unlocking their first one. This is due to an error by myself, where I uploaded a debug save to the Steam build my mistake. My sincere apologies. 

Unfortunately, this fix only works for those who installed the game in-between the last patch and today's and haven't launch the game. If the game crashes the first time it launches, that's the script working. Please attempt to launch the game again, everything should be fixed then. For those who already experienced the achievement bug, It is beyond my ability to check which user fell victim to my stupidity and fix everything via a simple script, I am sorry. If you do want to fix it and reset your achievement progress, please contact us either in the Steam forums or Discord.
